syllabus_topics: Part I - Multi-component Mixtures and Humid Air
Mass and Energy Balance. Thermal Comfort and Thermal Load
Processes with Humid Air. Air Conditioning. Psychrometric Diagram
Thermochemistry. Enthalpy of Formation and Reaction, Heating Value
Vapor Cycles, Combined Cycles and Cogeneration
Organic Cycles, energy sources for organic cycles: Biomass, Geothermal, industrial thermal effluents. Solar Energy
Gas Turbine. Aeronautical and Industrial Applications
Refrigeration Machines and Heat Pumps. Vapor Compression and Absorption Cycles

assessment_methods.method: Continuous Assessment (3 tests: MAP45 Part I, MAP45 Part II, EXAM Part III)

assessment_rules: Students can choose between continuous assessment (arithmetic average of three tests) or a final exam. The final grade will be the best of the two options. Approval requires an arithmetic average of the three tests or the final exam grade to be greater than 9.5 out of 20. MAP1 or MAP2 can be retaken on the day of the EXAM.
bibliography: M.J. Moran and H. N. Shapiro, “ Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics”, John Wiley & Sons Publishers
Çengel, Y.A. e Boles, M.A., "Thermodynamics: an engineering approach", McGraw-Hill, 1994
Reynolds, W. e Perkins, H.C., "Engineering Thermodynamics", McGraw-Hill, 1977
Oates, G.C., "Aerothermodynamics of Gas Turbine and Rocket Propulsion", AIAA, 1988
Haywood, R.W., "Analysis of Engineering Cycles", Pergamon Press, 1991
